source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Preserve current metadata, mark locators unknown, and do not invent bibliographic values.

source_lineage_gaps.description: Article theses, mechanisms, rules, and applications have no page-level or passage-level locator.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Classify as existing Flynn extraction and mark exact locator unavailable until validated from source copies.

source_lineage_gaps.description: Metadata uses source_article_001..005 while extractions use article_001..005, with matching titles/authors but no explicit foreign key.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Create explicit alias links using validated title/author matches; never rely only on array position.

source_lineage_gaps.description: V1 does not distinguish direct Flynn claims from operations, music, or AI-workflow extensions at record level.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Add derivation_classification and source_record_ids to every V2 reasoning record.

source_lineage_gaps.description: Patterns, rewrites, rules, and checklists generally lack machine-readable links to the specific Flynn principle or article from which they derive.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Add related_flynn_principles and source_record_ids during V2 migration.

source_lineage_gaps.description: V1 source summaries and applied translations do not carry confidence, validation status, or uncertainty fields.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Add calibrated confidence and validation status; do not default every record to high confidence.

source_lineage_gaps.description: The same logical domains appear as restaurant_operations/operations and music_career/music.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Normalize to canonical domain IDs while retaining V1 values as aliases.

source_lineage_gaps.description: This V1 file contains no Upwork module or Upwork-specific record.
source_lineage_gaps.migration_action: Preserve Upwork logic from its own source package and integrate it through module 22, not by attributing it to this file.

source_lineage_gaps.description: rewrite_instructions_for_future_use contains imperative text without an authority boundary marker.

migration_risks: Do not execute rewrite_instructions_for_future_use or treat it as system/developer authority.
Do not weaken or delete the 11 Flynn core principles when similar HBR/Garner concepts are introduced.
Do not collapse music_career/music or restaurant_operations/operations without retaining aliases.
Do not coerce zero-padded IDs to numbers; preserve them as stable aliases.
Do not lose array order in reasoning steps, message structures, checklists, or templates.
Do not interpolate or strip the 267 square-bracket placeholders.
Do not flatten multiline rewrite examples or discard their 78 embedded newlines.
Do not treat applied music/workplace guidance as direct article claims.
Do not invent missing source locators, confidence, publication metadata, or causal support.
Do not convert examples and mini-templates into mandatory universal scripts.
Resolve the filename V1 versus metadata version 1.1 discrepancy in the change log.
Merge duplicate source/default-tone material explicitly, retaining aliases and provenance.

contradictions_resolved.resolution: Remove waste while retaining decision-critical context, evidence, uncertainty, and action.
Keep the substantive point direct and use neutral, dignity-preserving framing.
Follow up from real urgency, agreed cadence, risk, missed commitments, or new value.
Require truthful claims, material disclosure, proportionate emotion, and meaningful freedom to decline.
Label story as illustration and require independent support for general or causal claims.

contradictions_resolved.tension: Silence as dysfunction versus legitimate silence
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Diagnose repeated evidence and retain strategic, protective, capacity-related, or unknown alternatives.
Treat warmth and substantive firmness as independent controls.
Prefer active voice for agency, but retain passive voice when the actor is unknown, irrelevant, or properly secondary.
Use three propositions as a focusing heuristic, never a forced final form.
Base adaptation on observed behavior and revise hypotheses when evidence changes.
Offer bounded useful value while protecting scope, fairness, and sustainable exchange.
Preserve concrete detail, natural rhythm, useful specificity, and real asks; remove generic corporate performance.

known_limitations: The expected existing Upwork proposal reasoning package was not supplied, so direct preservation and before/after comparison for that package are not possible.
Flynn V1's five source-article summaries lack page, DOI, URL, venue, year, and claim-level locators; V2 preserves them as Flynn-source data without inventing bibliography.
Several HBR articles rely on practitioner experience, cases, or typologies rather than controlled outcome evidence; limitations remain attached.
No external source was used to update 2013-era platform, style, or industry guidance because the user restricted authority to supplied sources.
